Name: Across the Aisle - Pierre and Morris Rival Hearts
Author: kcspace
Description:
[b][center][font=Arial][size=5]Love after divorce isn't easy, especially when you're falling for your sworn enemy.[/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eahJHRp.png[/img][size=5]﻿


Across the Aisle adds an enemies-to-lovers storyline for Pierre and Morris. Caroline rediscovers herself as a newly single woman, and Abigail navigates her relationship with her dad and his new boyfriend.
Adds 14 new heart events, over 50 new lines of dialogue (including 6 lines for Morris if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ is installed), an updated Community Center completion event when Pierre and Morris become friends, and a new apartment and schedule for Pierre.





[/size][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/jiBUmOm.png[/img][/size][size=5]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3712]Event Guide Found Here[/url]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h9iSQFj.png[/img]﻿
This mod [i]can[/i] be added to existing saves. By default, 7 full days must pass between events and the Community Center [i]must not[/i] be completed for events 1-3 and 8 to occur. You can turn off this requirement in the config options either by using General Mod Config Menu or by editing the config.txt file and changing "Incomplete Community Center" to false.



[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/qoPrNMP.png[/img]﻿
[size=5]
[/size][size=5]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿.[/size]


[/center][/b]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VQxE05N.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
A huge thank you to all the mod authors on the Stardew Valley Discord, in particular everyone who gave me advice and feedback in the Creative Writing thread. Thank you to SiTheGreat and Flashshifter for allowing me to edit a few parts of Morris Redeemed, and SVE's JojaMart storyline so that they made sense with this mod's story. Thank you to Airyn for adding DSV compatibility.
Thank you to my sibling for giving me much needed inspiration and constructive criticism, and not getting annoyed by all of the event videos I sent your way.
Thank you, as always, to my incredible spouse. You're forever and always my muse.[/size][/center]
